preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through social engineering/compromise)
Attacker needs some TeaToken balance to demonstrate the exploit

exploit_hint: As owner, call setTaxFeePercent() and setLiquidityFeePercent() with extremely high values (e.g., 99). Then perform a token transfer to trigger fee collection. The high fees will accumulate in the contract address, which can then be converted to ETH via swapAndLiquify and potentially extracted by the owner through liquidity removal or other mechanisms. The owner can also exclude themselves from fees using excludeFromFee() to avoid paying the high fees.
